deploy-bot: Started staged rollout r-2026-03-23-7 -> model-service v7.2.1; canary=5% (us-west). change_window=20:00-22:00 UTC. details: https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/r-2026-03-23-7 :rocket:
amanda: @suresh quick check — what are our exact auto-rollback thresholds for this path? I want to make sure docs match the runbook before we let it hit 5%.
suresh: current prod rule set (short): 5xx_rate > 1% sustained over 10m OR p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m -> trigger alert. we also have an adaptive rule: if relative 5xx doubles vs baseline for 3m + healthcheck fails -> auto-rollback.
leo: we added a new heuristic last quarter that requires verification step to pass before auto-rollback flips on for canaries. otherwise we get noise-induced rollbacks. verification = sampling of successful traces + schema checks.
amanda: right — that verification step is the one I want to validate. can we get the exact conditions?
suresh: verification criteria: sample >= 100 requests in canary window with < 0.5% schema errors AND no reranker mismatch alerts. if sampling < 100 in 10m, verification is considered inconclusive and we don't auto-rollback (but we still fire ops page).
jamie: fyi ops prefers we keep auto-rollback disabled for this canary and do manual stop/go. last time the auto-rollback flipped on a noisy client and caused extra churn. :grimacing:
ops-bot: Paging ops on request by @jamie — please standby for manual hold decision.
tanya: SGTM. I'll set the canary to manual rollback mode for this roll and enable full traces for canary traffic so we have enough samples.
deploy-bot: Update: canary mode set to: manual-rollback; trace_sampling=100% for rollout r-2026-03-23-7.
leo: small ask: can we also flip on the slow-path logging for 5xx to capture request_id and model inputs? saves time if we need to triage.
tanya: adding slow-path logging now — will push a non-blocking config to canary pool.
amanda: thanks. ops, what's our plan if we see a p95 jump to ~900ms but 5xx stays low? do we hold or continue?
ops-bot: Ops guideline (short): if p95 increase > 50% vs baseline but 5xx < 0.5% and error budget ok -> hold and run focused perf investigation 10m. escalate to rollback only if errors creep or p95 stays > 2x baseline after mitigations.
suresh: propose we add a short checklist to the thread so everyone knows the stop/go criteria for this rollout: 1) immediate HOLD if 5xx > 1% sustained 10m OR 5xx doubles vs baseline for 3m with failed verification; 2) HOLD and investigate if p95 > 2x baseline or p95 > 1200ms for 10m; 3) proceed only after traces validated and no schema/mismatch alerts.
jamie: that checklist looks good. I'd add: if we see memory pressure on model-serving nodes > 75% for 5m then hold and scale pool.
amanda: +1 to memory rule. add it as item 4.
suresh: noted. final checklist (for quick copy/paste into runbook):

```
ROLLBACK/STOP CRITERIA for r-2026-03-23-7
1) Auto-rollback (disabled for this canary): 5xx_rate > 1% sustained 10m OR 5xx_rate >= 2x baseline for 3m with failed verification
2) Manual HOLD: p95_latency > 2x baseline OR p95_latency > 1200ms for 10m
3) Manual HOLD: memory_pressure > 75% on serving nodes for 5m
4) Manual HOLD: schema errors or reranker mismatch alerts > 0.5% sample
Action: If HOLD triggered, ops run drill and either rollback (see command) or scale/patch and resume.
Rollback command (manual):

deployctl rollback --rollout r-2026-03-23-7 --to v7.1.9 --reason "canary-hold"
```

tanya: I'm going to paste that into the playbook and ping SRE for a quick review.
leo: SRE: @ops-sre can you sanity-check the thresholds? especially the memory one.
ops-bot: @ops-sre invited to thread.
ops-sre (automated): Acknowledged. Quick note: memory_pressure 75% for GPU hosts is tight — recommend 80% for GPUs, 75% for CPU-only pools. If this canary is on mixed pool, we'll follow 75% for conservative approach.
amanda: thanks. so consensus: keep auto-rollback off for this canary, use the checklist above, and hold at first sign of memory pressure or sustained p95/p50 divergence. schedule: we'll unpause at 21:40 UTC if checks look good.
suresh: I'll run a short staging rollback drill now so the team is familiar with the steps. low-impact test.
jamie: nice. who will be the on-call to make the final GO at 21:40?
tanya: I'll own the GO call and post final status here.
amanda: thx. last ask — can deploy-bot annotate rollout with the playbook link? makes future audits easier.
deploy-bot: Updated rollout metadata: playbook=https://wiki.redwood/internal/playbooks/preemptive-rollback-2026-03-23, mode=manual-rollback, owner=@tanya.
tanya: HOLDING canary at 5% until post-drill checks complete. will post results by 21:20 UTC. :eyes:
ops-bot: Canary status: PAUSED by @tanya; snapshot attached (link).
suresh: drill complete on staging. rollback command verified and timing measured ~18s to flip traffic. no surprises.
amanda: perfect. ping me at 21:15 with telemetry snapshot and I'll give thumbs up.
tanya: will do.
jamie: thanks everyone. if anything noisy pops, call rollback and tag this thread. :thumbsup:
